sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH rooms AS (
    SELECT
        sd.BUILDING_KEY,
        sd.FLOOR_KEY,
        sd.BUILDING_ROOM,
        sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME,
        sd.ROOM_NUMBER,
        sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
        sf.FLOOR_NAME
    FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
    JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
      ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
    JOIN BUILDINGS b
      ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
    WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32'
      AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = DATE '2024-12-19'
),
floor_stats AS (
    SELECT
        FLOOR_KEY,
        FLOOR_NAME,
        MAX(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS max_sqft,
        AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft
    FROM rooms
    GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY, FLOOR_NAME
),
largest_rooms AS (
    SELECT
        r.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.FLOOR_KEY
            ORDER BY r.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE DESC, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.ROOM_NUMBER
        ) AS rn
    FROM rooms r
)
SELECT
    r.FLOOR_NAME,
    r.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS largest_building_room_name,
    r.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS largest_room_square_footage,
    r.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME,
    r.ROOM_NUMBER,
    r.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    fs.avg_sqft AS average_room_square_footage_within_floor
FROM largest_rooms r
JOIN floor_stats fs
  ON fs.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
WHERE fs.max_sqft > 100
  AND r.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10
ORDER BY r.FLOOR_NAME, r.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE;

sql_reading_B.sql:
WITH loaded_rooms AS (
    SELECT
        sd.BUILDING_KEY,
        sd.FLOOR_KEY,
        sd.BUILDING_ROOM,
        sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME,
        sd.ROOM_NUMBER,
        sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
        sf.FLOOR_NAME
    FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
    JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
      ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
    JOIN BUILDINGS b
      ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
    WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32'
      AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = DATE '2024-12-19'
),
qualified_floors AS (
    SELECT
        FLOOR_KEY,
        FLOOR_NAME,
        MAX(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS max_sqft,
        AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft
    FROM loaded_rooms
    GROUP BY FLOOR_KEY, FLOOR_NAME
    HAVING MAX(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) > 100
),
all_floor_rooms AS (
    SELECT
        sd.*,
        sf.FLOOR_NAME
    FROM SPACE_DETAIL sd
    JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf
      ON sf.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY
    JOIN BUILDINGS b
      ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
    WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32'
)
SELECT
    qf.FLOOR_NAME,
    lr.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS largest_building_room_name,
    lr.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS largest_room_square_footage,
    afr.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME,
    afr.ROOM_NUMBER,
    afr.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    qf.avg_sqft AS average_room_square_footage_within_floor
FROM qualified_floors qf
JOIN (
    SELECT x.*
    FROM loaded_rooms x
    WHERE x.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (
        SELECT MAX(y.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE)
        FROM loaded_rooms y
        WHERE y.FLOOR_KEY = x.FLOOR_KEY
    )
) lr
  ON lr.FLOOR_KEY = qf.FLOOR_KEY
JOIN all_floor_rooms afr
  ON afr.FLOOR_KEY = qf.FLOOR_KEY
WHERE afr.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10
ORDER BY qf.FLOOR_NAME, afr.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE;

question_text: For each floor in the Stata building (building 32), for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, where the largest room square footage on the floor is greater than 100, give the floor name, the name of the building room with the largest square footage, the largest room square footage, and for each space unit on that floor with a room square footage greater than 10, show the building room name, room number, room square footage, and the average room square footage within the floor, ordered by floor name and then by room square footage. Do not return any rounded answers.

spans.text: for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24
